CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #13
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   B. Refusing to help a neighbour
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   D. Skipping all moral lessons

2. Which response best shows understanding of Self-awareness? (1 mark)
   A. Use Self-awareness to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Self-awareness with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Self-awareness has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Self-awareness.

3. Which response best shows understanding of The Annunciation? (1 mark)

   D. Say Making choices has no place in daily life.

   A. Spreading rumours
   B. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   C. Hiding stolen items
   D. Cheating in exams

----
